Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 61

“Restraining them all, one should sit absorbed, intent on me. For one whose senses are mastered, wisdom is firmly set.”

Here is the piece missing from the previous verse: mat-parah, intent on me. Krishna's answer to force failing is not more force but a redirection of attention toward something worth it.
